messages:
ajay: Quick triage - two customers reported billing landing on org instead of their project after the new auth-proxy rollout. Traces point to missing project claim during token exchange.
sofia: confirmed in traces: exchange returns project claim ~70% on new path; ~30% are projectless and hit org fallback.
maria: any logs to repro?
ajay: redacted log:
[auth] exchange result: claims={} for sub=svc-314
[routing] effective_project=null fallback=org-21
sofia: old proxy synthesized x-origin-project when the claim was missing; new gateway assumes exchange always sets project.
kai: we cannot use synthesized project for authorization. If we infer it, mark it telemetry-only and run privacy review.
maria: proposal: auth-service emits an `effective_project` tag used only for billing/telemetry and a sampled `auth.fallback` event when exchange lacks project. No exposure in audit logs.
sofia: impl sketch: `effective_project = claims.get('project') or infer_from_token_meta()` then `if not claims.get('project'): sampler.emit('auth.fallback', payload={'project_hint': effective_project})`. Start sampling at 5%.
ajay: metrics plan: `auth.fallback.count{reason="no_project"}` + aggregated `auth.fallback.by_cohort` derived from sampled events to avoid high cardinality.
maria: Console: show a small "likely project" badge on billing rows when confidence >=60% and a reconcile button that runs a dry-run reattribution job.
kai: privacy checklist: legal review required before increasing sampling. Gate rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% only after sign-off.
sofia: add a debug toggle `auth.debug_full_attribution` support can enable per-customer for triage; toggles must create audit entries.
ajay: ops plan: canary auth-service with sampler at 5%, monitor `auth.fallback.count` and billing drift. GH issue + privacy reviewer now.
maria: I'll draft console PR for the badge and reconcile flow.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-service@canary -> routing-proxy@stable; canary 5%. CI green.
ajay: action items assigned. Ping infra-oncall if billing drift >2%. :thumbsup:
